topic: 系统挂起是否计入经过时间
document_version: man-pages 6.19; page dated 2026-03-07; HTML colophon reports tarball fetched 2026-09-09
supported_claims: On Linux CLOCK_MONOTONIC excludes system suspend; CLOCK_BOOTTIME includes it.
Monotonic ordering does not by itself specify suspend accounting.
own_derivation: Ideal same-clock difference over 2 active seconds, 30 suspended seconds and 1 active second is 3 excluding suspend or 33 including it. A local 10-second deadline therefore has 7 seconds remaining or has elapsed.
limits: Source-backed explanation and paper arithmetic, not a clock invocation or suspend test.
No claim about a game engine clock mapping, callback execution during suspend, wake-up behavior or server session authority.
